Input: the old test enlarged the engine's loaded role document (engine._documents['identity_review'][0], the memo of contracts.all_prompt_documents over the installed skill files) past the profile limit of 2,000,000 bytes. A Sim test changes no engine state behind the product (설계 4.1), so the new test reaches the same product condition from the other side: after the review opened, the public configure and probe (support.engine_overflow.apply_limit, as the CLI's configure) adopt a profile edition whose limit is the byte size of the identity review's installed documents, and the attempt is prepared under that edition, so the mandatory common documents alone exceed its actual limit. The old test avoided editing the configuration projection behind the profile registry; the public path changes the registry itself. Every old assertion is kept; the added one pins the product's cause (common_documents_or_governance) and the limit in the overflow record. Start state as the other moved engine tests: the purpose scenario on a Sim (support.review_research.research_sim) instead of purpose_fixtures.purpose_state on real Jobs with the signed formal fixture and adapter_for patched.

Input: the old runner (StoppedInvestigator) returned status 'stopped' for the investigation without any stop request (it called should_stop and ignored the answer). The product runner reports 'stopped' only after the owner's stop judgment (model_runner sets stopped when should_stop() is true or the runner's own deadline passes, and an investigation is a work role without a call deadline), so that input cannot arise from the product. The new test makes a real stop of that one execution: with the Jobs fake live, the investigator writes the same blocked checkpoint while the user replaces the research grant it holds by public control; the owner revokes that grant, requests a stop of its consumers (grant_revoked) and terminates the Job at the investigator's next turn, while the instance keeps running. Every old assertion is kept; the added ones pin that stop path (the execution's stop reason and outcome, the failed_investigation_returned history row). Start state as the other moved engine tests (support.review_research.research_sim).
